idea.title: See a different side of Seoul.
idea.p1: Seoul can be loud, fast and crowded.
idea.p2: But there is another side of the city — quiet temples, forest paths, warm food and long conversations over tea.
idea.p3: This small-group experience is designed to help you slow down and experience Seoul like a local.

photo.p2: No awkward posing. Just a few moments that feel like your actual day in Seoul.

host.title: Meet your local host
host.body: I'm a Korean local who enjoys showing visitors a quieter side of Seoul. Instead of rushing through a checklist of attractions, I want to share a few places, foods and moments that I genuinely enjoy.

audience.title: This experience is for you if…
items: You've already seen Seoul's biggest landmarks.
You want something slower than a typical city tour.
You enjoy food, nature and local culture.
You want to experience Seoul with a local rather than a large tour group.
You'd like a few beautiful photos of your trip.
audience.note: This is an easy nature walk, but comfortable shoes are recommended.

group.label: Planned group size
group.title: Small group. Slow pace.
group.body: The experience is planned for a small group, leaving space for natural conversation, flexible pacing, better photos and a more personal day. Final arrangements are still being worked out.

items.a: No. The experience focuses on Korean culture, nature, food and everyday local life. Guests do not need to be religious.

items.q: Do I need to be fit?
items.a: The planned route includes an easy forest walk rather than a strenuous hike. Comfortable shoes are recommended.

items.q: Will you take photos of us?
items.a: Your host plans to take a few natural travel photos during the experience.

items.q: Is the experience available every day?
items.a: The schedule is currently being finalized.
The experience is designed for small groups, and solo travelers may be able to join depending on the final booking structure.
